text: ukucula nokutshiloza kwezinyoni kungikhumbuza elakithi nge-ilkisirati
laba bangabantwana baka-ana, ngodishani no-oholibhama, indodakazi ka-ana
othisha mabazame izibonelo baphinde bakhuthaze abantwana, ukuthola inkulumo ecacile eqondile engenakudiyazela
isiko lokulobola ngezinkomo ukuhlanganisa intombi nensizwa, liphambili kulesi sizwe samamasayi
iminyaka eyishumi nambili bamkhonza ukedorlawomere, kepha ngonyaka weshumi nantathu bahlubuka
kuthi makasondele ewindini lomshayeli abuye azikhuze
igama layo laliqala ngo, kangisalikhumbuli lonke
ngikhalela nezingane zakhe ngithi mazilale ngenxeba
wezwakala esethi: hhayi, impela unenhliziyo enhle.
uma ungunobhala womhlangano kuyadingeka ukuthi ukwazi ukufinyeza, yonke ingxoxo ebeyidingidwa emhlanganweni
nango engena oweloli elithwele isigubhukazi engingasazi ukuthi sigcwele muthi muni
uma sike satholana kukhona oyongcwatshwa phakathi wethu
balinde kuze kube sengathi bakulowaya mugqa omdala waseposini
abantwana mabaholwe ukuba bakhethe zonke izenzo ezikhona
athi usigaxamabhande lona uyazi yini ukuthi ungaxoshelwa lento oyenzile
ubengeke athi umuntu ezigxumela engena emotweni; nami ngibe ngiphuma ngintantatheka ngimlandela
kwavele kwafika nje insizwa elunge kanjani
umndeni ka-esawu. lezi yizizukulwane zika-esawu ongu-edomi
ngenxa yemfuyo isizwe samamasayi siphila impilo yonozulazulane, omanxiwa kamili mbuya
sithi sona asikwazi ukufunda lamagondoviya esandla
kwakusobala nokho ukuthi usabuyisa ingqondo ugumede
ungichazela ukuthi izingane zakhe ngabe zafunda
nakini nonke ngiyaxolisa ngendlela enganginiphatha ngayo
bamokha ngensini asebenza nabo, esesebenza ngokuzibulala
sekudala kufuneka ngiyibhale kodwa ngeswela ongangibhalela yona
kungabhalwa isigaba abantwana bonke basifinyeze. bese kuxoxwa ngemisebenzi yabo eyahlukene
